articles.summary: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. (“SmartStop”) (NYSE: SMA), a self-managed real estate investment trust and a premier owner and operator of self-storage facilities in the United States and Canada, announced today that it has commenced an underwritten public offering of 7,000,000 shares of its common stock, par value $0.001 per share, in connection with the forward sale agreements described below. J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo Securities, KeyBanc Capital Markets, BMO Capital Markets and Truist Securities are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering. In connection with the offering, SmartStop expects to enter into forward sale agreements with affiliates of each of J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo Securities (the “forward purchasers”) with respect to 7,000,000 shares of SmartStop’s common stock. articles.summary: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. (“SmartStop” or “the Company”), a self-managed and fully-integrated self storage company, announced its overall results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 Financial Highlights: Net income attributable to common stockholders was approximately $9.0 million. This represents an increase of approximately $3.8 million when compared to the same period in 2025. Net income per share of Common Stock, (basic and diluted) was $0.16. This represents an increase of approximately $0.07 per share when compared to the same period in 2025. Total self storage-related revenues were approximately $68.2 million, an increase of approximately $3.6 million when compared to the same period in 2025. FFO, as adjusted (attributable to common stockholders and Operating Partnership (“OP”) unit holders), was approximately $30.3 million, an increase of approximately $2.9 million when compared to the same period in 2025.
